sources.title: Current leadership biography
sources.findings: Current chairman/CEO; joined 1996 after Chupa Chups; Barcelona origin; ESADE MBA and Thunderbird Master in International Management.
sources.caution: Corporate strategy aspirations not independent proof of health or environmental benefits. Old biography PDF returned 404; current HTML used.

sources.title: Ramón Laguarta: birth entry
sources.caution: Year only from secondary source; no exact day/month or primary birth certificate verified. Do not repeat first-Spanish-CEO superlative or unsourced exact education years.

sources.title: 21 May 2026: award and alumni-day conversation
sources.findings: Reports award acceptance and conversation at L’Auditori Barcelona; corroborates MBA and international management master.
sources.caution: Publication date not independently established exact event day; award not a new academic degree. No second MBA inferred for Thunderbird.

sources.title: August 2018 Form 8-K: CEO succession
sources.findings: CEO/director effective October 3, 2018; president September 2017; Spain Snacks marketing VP 1996.
sources.caution: August 3 board decision and August 6 announcement are not effective date; Nooyi initially retained chairmanship.

sources.title: January 2019 Form 8-K: chairman succession
sources.findings: Chairman effective February 1, 2019, succeeding Indra Nooyi.
sources.caution: January filing is advance notice; current biography and subsequent tenure corroborate completed transition.

sources.title: 15 September 2021: corrected pep+ launch release
sources.findings: pep+ launch covering agriculture, value chain and product choices; original net-zero goal 2040.
sources.caution: Corrected release restores missing opening; goals, imagined products and future benefits are not completed outcomes. Targets later revised.

sources.title: 19 May 2025: poppi acquisition completion
sources.findings: PepsiCo closed poppi acquisition; portfolio expansion into soda brand.
sources.caution: Not March agreement date or personal acquisition. Quote is Ram Krishnan, not Ramon Laguarta; brand prebiotic positioning not verified health efficacy.

sources.title: 22 May 2025: sustainability targets revised
sources.findings: Net-zero ambition changed from 2040 to 2050 or sooner; packaging targets also revised.
sources.caution: Read opening and climate/packaging comparison, not underlying climate-accounting reports. Corporate rationale attributed; no claim emissions targets met.

sources.title: 30 January 2026: board election
sources.caution: Director, not IBM CEO or chairman; announcement precedes effective date.

sources.title: Current director biography
sources.findings: Director since 2026, Directors and Corporate Governance committee; PepsiCo chairman and CEO.
sources.caution: Current roster corroborates appointment occurred, not merely proposed.

sources.title: 8 October 2026: third-quarter earnings release
sources.findings: Attributed remarks on international performance, North American improvement and future cost actions.
sources.caution: Read release opening and remarks, not full financial exhibits. Future cost actions not completed savings; no inference of physical attendance.
